'''Players Guide through Dagobah (Scrye 4.3)''' is the August 1997 ''[[Scrye]]'' 4.3 magazine insert of a 40-page Players Guide. The booklet prints game text and card information from [[Premiere Limited|Premiere]] through [[Dagobah Limited|Dagobah]].<ref name="enc183">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf#page=183 SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 183–184 (Magazine Coverage). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261009141805/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="enc20mag">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/SWCCG+Collecting+Encyclopedia+2.0.pdf#page=50 SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 2.0], pp. 50–52 (Magazine Promotions). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261024031553/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/SWCCG+Collecting+Encyclopedia+2.0.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>

The cover is Boba Fett art. The issue also packed a Jedi Test contest, a [[First Anthology]] article, and Dagobah strategy articles.<ref name="enc20mag" />
